about: I'm a final-year B.Tech CSE student at Vellore Institute of Technology (Bhopal, MP) with a 9.26/10 CGPA, actively seeking Full Stack Developer roles to build scalable web applications within collaborative engineering teams.

My core technical ground spans full-stack development using Java, Spring Boot, ReactJS, and NestJS, complemented by practical expertise in real-time systems (event-driven architecture, PostGIS, Redis caching) and applied AI/ML (CNNs, OpenCV, NLP).

I've published research at the IDBA 2025 International Conference and contributed across high-impact projects including an intelligent traffic analysis platform, an AI health management mobile app, and enterprise blockchain dApps on ICP.

bullets: Completed a dual-track internship in advanced software engineering and applied AI/ML, delivering two capstone projects.

Built a 5-service FastAPI AI platform integrating a Keras/TensorFlow CNN (60,000+ images) for product classification, OpenCV facial recognition, and an NLP sentiment/intent chatbot for retail intelligence.
Developed a full-stack ASP.NET Core MVC library management system (EF Core 8, Dockerized MySQL) with an automated borrowing/due-date engine and a glassmorphism analytics dashboard.
Built a full-stack CRUD application on Internet Computer Protocol (ICP), enabling efficient on-chain data management.
Designed a DAO-based course management system with role-based access, applying dApp architecture patterns end to end.

projects.title: Real-Time Traffic Intelligence System (UDIE)
bullets: Architected a scalable, real-time traffic analysis platform using event-driven architecture and H3 spatial indexing; integrated Redis caching to cut query response time by ~40% under peak load.
Developed a cross-platform Flutter mobile app and web dashboard with a NestJS backend, including automated anomaly detection and live alerting.

projects.title: LifeTrack — AI Health Management App
bullets: Designed and built an AI-powered mobile health app delivering personalised fitness/nutrition plans, using OOP/MVC in Android Studio with MySQL-backed REST API data sync.
Research on the AI recommendation model and application architecture was accepted and published at the IDBA 2025 International Conference.
